'''2000 DecipherCon 8-Man (Friday, Clay Ramey)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event (8-man) held in Kissimmee, Florida on 6 October 2000. [[Clay Ramey]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1335">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-2kd1335/ deciphercon-2k], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-deciphercon-2kd1335/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Clay Ramey]]
